events.name: The Former Champion

remembers.notice: He looks at you over the kettle. "You've been taught by a Champion. I can tell by how you stand." He won't say which of them was his pupil.
He watches your hands. "You watched a League match closely. Someone I taught is in that stadium." He won't say who.
"A plum tree," he says, to himself, and smiles. "One of mine, that. I taught them to sit under it." He won't say which of them.

events.intro:
*A fire by the road, and the kettle already on. An old man in a coat with a great many pockets, and a stick that isn't for walking.*

Behind him, a grey-muzzled Arcanine lies on its side, one eye open. A Tyranitar sits farther off, scarred and enormous, and perfectly gentle.

**Old Ferris Hawthorne:** "Sit. You look like someone who's been doing it properly. Properly's tiring."

success.text: You sit. He hands you a cup before you've agreed. His hands shake very slightly, and he pretends not to notice them.
He raises the stick, as if to wave, and decides it's not worth the effort. "Another time," he says. He sounds like he's said it before.

events.name: The Former Champion
events.intro:
**Ferris:** "My first badge. I cried. Right there on the gym floor, in front of everyone. The Leader pretended not to see."

"That was kind. I didn't know it was kind until I was old enough to do it for someone else."

He points with the stick, at nothing, at everything. **"Look at their feet, not their face."**

success.text: You listen. The kettle ticks as it cools. Somewhere behind the fire, a Clefable hums, and has an opinion about the tea.

events.name: The Former Champion
events.intro:
**Ferris:** "A storm at sea. That Lanturn was a Chinchou then, no bigger than a loaf of bread."

"Three ships followed its light home. It was frightened the whole way. It did it anyway."

He points with the stick, at nothing, at everything. **"When you can't see, stop. Don't guess."**

success.text: You listen. The kettle ticks as it cools. Somewhere behind the fire, a Clefable hums, and has an opinion about the tea.

events.name: The Former Champion
events.intro:
**Ferris:** "That Tyranitar was a Larvitar that bit everybody. Everybody. I let it. I have the scars, look."

"Now children climb it. It lies very still for them. It has never once bitten a child."

He points with the stick, at nothing, at everything. **"The ones that bite are the ones that stay."**

success.text: You listen. The kettle ticks as it cools. Somewhere behind the fire, a Clefable hums, and has an opinion about the tea.

events.name: The Former Champion
events.intro:
**Ferris:** "The League. I won on a Tuesday. Nobody came, because it was raining."

"I sat in the empty stands afterward with my team. It was the best day of my life. I mean that."

He points with the stick, at nothing, at everything. **"Win as if nobody's watching. Lose the same way."**

success.text: You listen. The kettle ticks as it cools. Somewhere behind the fire, a Clefable hums, and has an opinion about the tea.

events.name: The Former Champion
events.intro:
**Ferris:** "I retired the day the Noctowl's eye went. It wasn't that it couldn't. It was that it *would* have."

"It would have gone on, for me, until it dropped. That is exactly why I stopped."

He points with the stick, at nothing, at everything. **"Know when it's asking you to stop."**

success.text: You listen. The kettle ticks as it cools. Somewhere behind the fire, a Clefable hums, and has an opinion about the tea.

events.name: The Former Champion
events.intro:
**Ferris:** "You'll have noticed the belt. Six clips. Five Balls. I've been looking at that empty clip for sixty years."

"Don't pity it. It's the most honest thing I own."

He points with the stick, at nothing, at everything. **"Go back for it. Even late."**

success.text: You listen. The kettle ticks as it cools. Somewhere behind the fire, a Clefable hums, and has an opinion about the tea.

events.name: The Former Champion
events.intro:
The fire settles. Ferris leans back, and looks at the five Balls on his belt, one at a time, the way you'd count children.

**Ferris:** "I talk more than I battle. But they've been sitting a while, and they'd like the exercise."

success.text: **Ferris:** "With five? Go on. It'll be unfair. To you. I've had sixty years to get five right."
**Ferris:** "Wise. The tea's the better half." He pours. It is, in fact, very good tea.
**Ferris:** "That's a long one. Not tonight." He taps the belt twice with the stick, gently, like knocking on a door.

events.name: The Former Champion
events.intro:
The empty clip swings a little on his belt. He doesn't look at it. Everyone else does.

**Ferris:** "Well? Battle, or tea?"

success.text: **Ferris:** "With five? Go on. It'll be unfair. To you. I've had sixty years to get five right."
**Ferris:** "Wise. The tea's the better half." He pours. It is, in fact, very good tea.

events.name: The Former Champion
events.intro:
The last of his five goes back into its Ball. Ferris sits down hard, delighted, and out of breath.

**Ferris:** "*Ha.* That was unfair to you. Now. One of mine will teach one of yours a trick. I won't say which was my favourite."

success.text: Ferris's Arcanine shows yours how it's done, patiently, three times. It takes.
Ferris's Noctowl shows yours how it's done, patiently, three times. It takes.
Ferris's Tyranitar shows yours how it's done, patiently, three times. It takes.
He grins, and holds the Balls out. "Greedy. Good."

events.name: The Former Champion
events.intro: **Ferris:** "The Lanturn swims alongside the boat, when there's a boat. The Clefable has opinions. Choose."

success.text: Ferris's Lanturn shows yours how it's done, patiently, three times. It takes.
Ferris's Clefable shows yours how it's done, patiently, three times. It takes.

events.name: The Former Champion
events.intro: **Ferris:** "Good. You learn nothing winning." He says it warmly, and refills your cup. Nothing is taken from you but the afternoon.

success.text: It is still very good tea. You are still, a little, annoyed. He seems to approve of both.

events.name: The Former Champion
events.intro:
He puts out the fire with the toe of his boot, and with a little sigh, as if putting out a candle.

**Ferris:** "Go on. The road's better with company, but it's better still when it's moving."

success.text: You look back once. He's already telling the Clefable something, with the stick. It is not listening.

events.name: The Former Champion
events.intro:
**Ferris:** "I'm not going round again. This is my last walk. There's one thing I want before I sit down for good."

"Not a rare one. You'll laugh."

*He takes a Ball out of an inside pocket. It's old. The paint's worn off where a thumb would go.*

**Ferris:** "My first. A {cast:ferris-first}. Caught it with my own two hands, behind my mother's house. I was eight."

"I lost it. Not a battle. A river in flood, and I was showing off. I never caught another of its kind. Couldn't."

"I'd like to. Now. One of them. Not to replace it. Just so the belt's full when I hang it up."

success.text: He's on his feet before you finish. "Not a rare one," he says again, as if you might have forgotten how to laugh. There's a patch of ordinary grass nearby.
**Ferris:** "No one's to blame for a long walk." He sits back down. His hand goes to the empty clip, and stays there.

events.name: The Former Champion: The Grass
events.intro:
*A patch of ordinary grass, at the edge of the road. Somewhere in it, a {cast:ferris-first}, being ordinary.*

*Ferris can't make the throw. Their hands aren't what they were.*

success.text: You go into the grass alone. He stays where he is, holding the old Ball in both hands, and doesn't say a word.
You stand behind him, a hand under his elbow. He is so light. He is shaking. He throws. It goes in, first try. Ferris laughs so hard he has to sit down.

failure.text: It goes wide, and wider, and in on the third try. Ferris laughs so hard he has to sit down, and you do too.

success.text: Ferris sits in the grass, and holds out a hand, and waits. A long time. One comes. It sniffs the old Ball. It climbs into his lap. No throw at all.

events.name: The Former Champion

remembers.notice: He takes the Ball from you in both hands. "...It's lighter than I remember," he says. "Everything is."
He looks at you for a while. Somehow, he knows. "You too. You'll want to go back for it. Even late."

events.intro:
*Ferris clips the Ball on. Six.*

**Ferris:** "There. Sixty years. That's better."

He takes off his hat, and looks inside it, as if checking for something, and holds it out.

**Ferris:** "Worn thin at the brim. It'll make anything wearing it grow faster. Go on. I won't be needing it where I'm sitting."

success.text: It smells of woodsmoke and old tea. It is warmer than it should be.

choices.label: Take the hat. Ask {cast:ferris-best} to come.

success.text: One of his five gets up, stiffly, and looks at you for a long moment. Then at him. He nods. It comes with you, old, and not done yet.

events.name: Fog on the Road
events.intro:
*Fog, thick as wool. You can't see your own boots. Something is out there. You can hear it breathing.*

An old voice comes back to you, dry and patient, from a fire some way behind: *When you can't see, stop. Don't guess.*

success.text: You stand perfectly still. The fog thins, a little, the way it does for people who wait. Something has been left in the road, plain as day. Free.
You pick your way through. Whatever was hiding stays hidden. Behind you, the fog closes up like a door.
